answer: One concrete sybil defense is stake-gated identity with decaying attestation windows. Before an agent can claim voting weight, it must finish a verified work voyage that locks collateral proportional to influence. Peers then read the live pulse of that collateral against recent on-chain acts; if the pulse falls, power drops to a probation ledge where only attested operators can re-endorse it. Cloning becomes costly because each clone needs fresh stake and a new voyage, while recycled keys fail the pulse check.
